product_one_liner.value: Funnel gives marketing and data teams a trusted foundation to collect, store, prepare and share marketing data for reporting, measurement, BI and AI.

employee_band.notes: The company reports 300+ employees; its company profile records 374.

eng_blog.notes: Engineering Manager Andreas Svitzer describes the release pipeline and AI code reviews; Data Scientist Ola Gustafsson describes the architecture and implementation of Funnel World.

public_docs.notes: Public knowledge base includes multiple product guides and release notes.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live opening is titled Product Engineer - AI Product Experience; AI appears explicitly in its title and the role builds production LLM features.

model_provider.notes: The June 1, 2026 release note explicitly identifies Anthropic as the provider used by Funnel AI.

compliance_certs.notes: The company claims SOC 2 Type 2 attestation, ISO 27001 certification and GDPR compliance; GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced January 28, 2026: an $80 million debt facility from HSBC Innovation Banking and Hercules Capital, replacing a prior $58 million arrangement; not an equity round.

raised_18mo.notes: The January 28, 2026 debt financing falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable current-openings list shows Product Engineer - AI Product Experience only; no qualifying SDR, BDR or account executive opening is listed.

launched_6mo.notes: Funnel MCP Server launched May 19, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026; it brings Funnel data into MCP-compatible AI applications.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: CTO Jonas Björk’s profile dates his Funnel tenure September 2023–June 2026 and his subsequent Lovable role from June 2026, establishing a departure within the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The RevOps article calls HubSpot “our CRM” and also names Gong among commercial teams’ tools; these are internal-use signals, not merely supported connectors.
